title: Parents see a hooded being in their bedroom

tellings.quote: But my parents um saw a bean in their bedroom one night. Okay. hooded bean in their bedroom, which we never I never knew until Ray Fowler interviewed her.

plain: One night in the 1950s, near Allentown, Pennsylvania, a couple are said to have seen a hooded being standing in their bedroom. Their son, Jim Weiner, who has his own account of being taken by aliens, says he never knew about it until Ray Fowler, a UFO investigator, interviewed his mother. It would suggest such visits ran in the family.
